mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital declines.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 5.0% over three months signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over any 2-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline >1% monthly, or Rank IC over any 3-year window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate profits and increasing recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines from prior month, or Rank IC over any 3-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 3.0%, or Rank IC over any 2-year window falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: High employment levels (PAYEMS > 133,000 thousand) support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days as labor market strength persists.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 133,000 thousand, or Rank IC over any 5-year window falls below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars) accelerates retail sales and corporate revenue growth, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS > 350,000 million dollars, or Rank IC over any 2-year window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic slowdown, reducing corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both INDPRO and HOUST decline >1% monthly, or Rank IC over any 3-year window falls below 0.04.
